To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

college physical education is facing at least six dilemmas: the weak function of college physical education; the actual status being low of college physical education curriculum; the ignoring of college physical education by the current effective education system; the public opinions being indifferent to college physical education; college physical education theories' lacking guidance for practice; college physical education searches' lacking guidance for physical education.

the author believes that college physical education should strengthen the functions of physical education, and improve physical education curriculum, physical education teaching, and physical education research.

college physical education is facing a series of realistic dilemmas, and the way out for resolving the realistic dilemmas is to strengthen the functions and status of college physical education, to strengthen physical education teaching, to improve the level of physical education teaching, and to promote the development of college physical culture.

the dilemmas of physical education in China are the reflection of the current physical education status, and they are also the reflection of the development of college physical culture.

the way out of the dilemmas of Chinese college physical education is the integration of the physical education curriculum with the current educational system, the improvement of the physical education theory, the establishment of the physical education teaching system, and the improvement of the teaching staff's teaching ability.

the dilemmas of the current college physical education in the country should be solved through strengthening the functions of the college physical education, enhancing the status of physical education in the education system, improving the public opinions' understanding of physical education, and promoting physical education theories' guidance for practice, etc.

we should make efforts to improve the status of college physical education and to make the development of college physical educations better.
we must strengthen the researches on physical education, improve the teaching quality, and promote the development of college physical educations.
the dilemmas of physical education in colleges and universities should be understood, and ways out should be found to promote the healthy development of college physical educations.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we should pay more attention to the development of college physical culture and sports, improve the quality of college physical education teaching and research, and promote the healthy growth of college students.

we should take a comprehensive approach, and take the development of physical education into consideration when we are building a new education system, reforming the education system, and improving education quality.
